look: chibi middle-aged chancellor of the State of Qi in the Spring and Autumn period (7th century BC): slim, clever narrow eyes, long thin black moustache and short pointed beard, hair in a topknot held by a small black lacquered crown-cap (guan) and a hairpin, cap tied with a cord under the chin, no brim, no side flaps, deep green cross-collared robe closing right-over-left (shenyi) with wide sleeves, red trim and a black sash, holding a bamboo-slip ledger. Pre-imperial Zhou dynasty clothing
